name: dsh-pager-grok
description: DeepSeek Harness external TUI backend and Grok-derived pager

scripts.build:ts: pnpm --filter './packages/dsh-tui-*' run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-pager-grok/runtime run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-pager-grok/runtime-apiproxy-v1 run build
scripts.test:ts: pnpm --filter './packages/dsh-tui-*' run test && pnpm --filter @dsh-pager-grok/runtime test && pnpm --filter @dsh-pager-grok/runtime-apiproxy-v1 test && pnpm --filter @dsh-pager-grok/cli test
scripts.verify:ts: pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run test:ts && node scripts/verify-runtime-pack.mjs && node scripts/verify-cli-pack.mjs && node scripts/verify-native-matrix.mjs
